app.name: Wondarta
app.tagline: Walk through it. Don't click through it.
app.glError: Something went wrong showing the 3D world. Please reload the page.

hub.hint: Walk with WASD or the arrow keys. Drag to look around. Tap the floor to walk there. Step into a glowing doorway to enter.

card.noVoice: No voice for this language on this device. You can still read along!

source.curatedTip: Written and reviewed by the Wondarta team.
source.aiGroundedTip: Written by AI using only the source shown. It was checked, but it was not reviewed by a person.
source.aiGeneratedTip: Friendly chat written by AI. It never contains facts.

ask.title: Ask about anything
ask.placeholder: What do you want to know?
ask.notFound: I looked on Wikipedia but couldn't find a good answer to that. Try asking another way!
ask.unsuitable: Let's pick a different topic. Ask a grown-up about that one!
ask.unverified: I found an article, but I couldn't explain it safely. Try a simpler question!
ask.offline: We're offline right now, but every room here still works!
ask.limit: That's all your free questions for this visit. Come back next time, or keep exploring the rooms!
ask.upgradeNote: Unlimited questions will come with a future family plan.

mascot.name: Wondoo
encourage: Hmm, not that one. Try again!
sleepLines: I'm resting my brain, but everything here is still yours to explore!
Zzz… I'm napping, but every room is still open. Go explore!
Shh, my thinking cloud is recharging. All the rooms still work!
mascot.openRecall: Tell me one thing you remember about {{title}}!
mascot.noTopics: Let's explore a portal together first. Then we can chat about it!
mascot.chatUnsafe: Let's talk about something else. If something is bothering you, tell a grown-up you trust.
greet: Yay, you came to visit me!
hello: Welcome back, {{name}}! Where shall we go today?
Welcome to the Great Hall! Pick a glowing doorway.

room.asleepBanner: Wondoo is asleep. Chat is paused, but all the rooms still work!

puzzle.tapPick: Tap a card, then tap where it goes. Or drag it!
puzzle.bump: Bump! That's a bug. Fix the program!
puzzle.notThere: The robot stopped, but not on the star. Debug it!
puzzle.tooMany: That's the most commands the robot can hold.
puzzle.lookScene: Look at the glowing objects next to the sign!
puzzle.memoryHint: Turn two cards over. Find all {{count}} pairs!
puzzle.mapHint: Tap the continent where this animal lives in the wild.
puzzle.flowerWhatNext: What grows next? Tap the right part.
puzzle.flowerHint: Not yet! A flower is built from the ground up, then from the outside in.
puzzle.flowerDoneNote: When a bee brings pollen to the pistil, the flower can make seeds.
puzzle.bodyWhich: Which organ goes in the glowing place?
puzzle.bodyDone: You put the body back together!
puzzle.bodyDoneNote: Every organ is now in its real place. Drag to look around.

tooltip.none: This word isn't in Wondarta's dictionary yet.

quiz.hintUsed: I took away one wrong answer for you!
quiz.wrongBody: Look again and try another answer.

room2.wake: Tap Wondoo to wake him up

settings.note: For grown-ups: language, picture quality, and the people whose work Wondarta uses. Pick Smooth if the world feels slow.
settings.resetConfirm: Start over? This forgets the name, the stars and the visited cards on this device.

critters.elephant: An African elephant! Its ears are shaped a bit like Africa.
critters.lion: A lion. Lions are the only cats that live in families, called prides.
critters.cub: A lion cub. It will stay with its mother for about two years.
critters.zebra: A zebra. Every zebra has its own pattern of stripes.
critters.giraffe: A giraffe — the tallest animal on land.
critters.rhino: A rhino. That horn is made of keratin, like your fingernails.
critters.hippo: A hippo. They spend the hot day in the water.
critters.fox: A fox. Foxes hunt by listening for tiny sounds.
critters.deer: A deer. It freezes when it hears something new.
critters.rabbit: A rabbit! Those long ears catch sounds from far away.
critters.owl: An owl. It can turn its head much further than you can.
critters.panda: A giant panda, all the way from the mountains of China.
critters.kangaroo: A red kangaroo, from Australia. One hop can cross a classroom.
critters.penguin: An emperor penguin, from Antarctica. Brrr!
critters.tap: Tap an animal to say hello
critters.bee: A bee! It is carrying pollen from flower to flower.
critters.sunflower: Sunflowers can grow taller than a grown-up!

card3.quizBlurb: {{count}} questions. Get them all for three stars!
card3.videoBlurb: Watch, then see what you remember.

welcome.hi: Hi! I'm Wondoo, an octopus in a rabbit costume. I'll explore with you. Which language do you like?
welcome.nameNote: Your name stays on this device.
welcome.walk: Nice to meet you, {{name}}! Walk with the arrow keys or W A S D. On a tablet, tap the floor to walk there, and drag to look around.
welcome.walkNoName: Nice to meet you! Walk with the arrow keys or W A S D. On a tablet, tap the floor to walk there, and drag to look around.
welcome.doors: Each glowing doorway in this hall leads to a world: animals, the ocean, the human body, art, history and more. Walk into one to go inside.
welcome.cards: Inside a world, walk up to anything that glows. A card opens. Read it, then press "Let's play!" for a game.
welcome.stars: Every game gives you up to 3 stars. Fewer slips, more stars! Your stars are counted up here.
welcome.ask: Curious about something else? Press the magnifying glass and ask me. I look it up on Wikipedia for you.
welcome.home: From any world, the little house brings you back to this hall. Ready, {{name}}? Let's explore!
welcome.homeNoName: From any world, the little house brings you back to this hall. Ready? Let's explore!
welcome.label: Welcome tour
